identity.description: 2NS Cybersecurity Oy is a Finnish‑based cybersecurity firm that designs, tests, and manages comprehensive information‑security solutions for businesses across sectors such as finance, healthcare, energy, logistics, and software. They serve clients throughout the Nordics, offering expertise, rapid response, and a trusted partnership to strengthen cyber resilience.

identity.name: Aalto
identity.slogan: Aalto-yliopisto – Siirry muutokseen
identity.description: Aalto University is a multidisciplinary Finnish university that combines science, technology, business, art and design to create innovative solutions for a sustainable future. It offers bachelor, master and doctoral programmes in fields such as engineering, economics, chemistry, architecture, arts, and information technology, taught in Finnish, Swedish and English. The university hosts a vibrant research community, providing state‑of‑the‑art facilities, research portals and collaborative projects across academia, industry and government. Aalto also supports entrepreneurship through its Founder School, Lifewide Learning initiatives, and extensive alumni and corporate partnerships. With a strong focus on sustainability, ethical principles and lifelong learning, Aalto University prepares students and researchers to address global challenges and drive societal impact.

Their product line ranges from the 1.5 kW AMT1500 for small‑scale needs to the 10 kW AMT10000 built for large farms, all featuring ultra‑silent operation, ultra‑low start‑up wind speeds (1.5 m/s), and storm‑proof, Arctic‑ready designs. Powered by AI‑driven pitch control, the turbines maximize energy yield, operate continuously in high winds, and are 100 % recyclable, making them ESG‑compliant and radar‑friendly. Amertate also offers battery storage solutions, professional installation services, and a full support ecosystem to help customers reduce energy costs, achieve energy independence, and meet sustainability goals.

identity.name: Aveksana
identity.slogan: Structure your research before you start writing.
identity.description: Aveksana is an AI‑powered research framing platform that helps universities, students, supervisors, and R&D teams structure the early stages of scholarly work. Their Research Logic Engine guides users from a broad idea to a defensible problem statement, defines scope, and clarifies the unique contribution before any drafting begins. Products include Artha for grant‑writing, TSS for thesis supervision, and Adveni for industrial R&D briefs. The service ensures data stays within Europe, offers enterprise‑grade security, and integrates with open research infrastructure. By automating premise selection, scope bounding, contribution identification, and structural validation, Aveksana accelerates thesis planning, proposal development, and project scoping while reducing supervisory workload and consulting costs.

identity.description: Frends is a European iPaaS provider that delivers a low‑code platform for enterprise integration, workflow automation, API management, and governed AI orchestration. The device records, stores and analyses data using AI‑driven algorithms, delivering SaaS‑based diagnostic support for primary‑care physicians, nurses, home‑monitoring and tele‑medicine. Backed by €2.2 million of pre‑seed funding, the team combines expertise in medicine, physics, hardware, software and business development. VitalSigns plans a 2027 launch in the Nordics followed by a European rollout, and is raising a seed round to fund manufacturing and go‑to‑market activities while building a proprietary clinical dataset moat.

identity.description: IQM builds full‑stack superconducting quantum computers that institutions can own and operate on‑premises or via the cloud. identity.slogan: Detect counterfeits. Manage risk. Own the intelligence.
identity.description: TrueMed is an AI‑driven brand protection platform dedicated to safeguarding pharmaceutical products from counterfeiting. identity.name: Vexlum
identity.slogan: High-power, narrow-linewidth VECSEL lasers for quantum technology and beyond
identity.description: VEXLUM is a Finnish spin‑off from the Optoelectronics Research Centre at Tampere University, developing VECSEL (vertical‑external‑cavity surface‑emitting laser) technology. The company delivers high‑power, low‑noise, single‑frequency semiconductor lasers with broad wavelength coverage in the visible and near‑infrared, tailored for quantum technology, medical diagnostics, and the semiconductor industry. Their compact laser systems combine the advantages of semiconductor lasers and external‑cavity disk lasers, offering high brightness, narrow linewidth, and application‑specific wavelength control.

identity.description: Visual Components provides an all‑in‑one manufacturing simulation platform that enables engineers, system integrators and production teams to design factory layouts, program robots offline, and virtually commission production lines. Their software combines 3D CAD integration, robot offline programming, and real‑time simulation to accelerate concept‑to‑reality workflows, improve decision‑making, and reduce costly errors. With a marketplace of partner add‑ons and tools for industries such as automotive, food & beverage, and life sciences, Visual Components helps over 2,400 companies visualize, optimize and sell automation solutions, supporting everything from layout optimization to sales acceleration and virtual testing.

identity.name: Zero Gravity
identity.slogan: Guaranteeing high-resolution thermal data where heat sources matter most.
identity.description: Zero Gravity Thermal is a Finnish space‑tech company that designs and builds high‑resolution thermal infrared payloads for CubeSats. Leveraging 20+ years of optics, photonics, and software expertise, the firm creates a unique thermal imaging capability aimed at urban and infrastructure applications. Their CubeSat‑compatible sensors deliver 100‑fold finer resolution than existing thermal satellites, enabling precise monitoring of renewable‑energy assets, smart‑city heat islands, oil spills, and disaster zones. Zero Gravity Thermal integrates edge AI for on‑board processing and provides actionable thermal maps through its UrbanAI analytics platform. Backed by ESA Phi‑Lab funding, the Cassini Business Accelerator, and multiple startup awards, the company serves paying clients across Europe, delivering data‑driven insights for energy, water, and city‑management sectors.
